text:
[Council File 26-1648; CD 5]
Municipal Facilities Committee report relative to authorizing the General Services Department to negotiate and execute a no-cost, revocable license agreement with The Grove, LLC for the installation and operation of Los Angeles Police Department drone-related equipment on rooftop space located at 189 The Grove Drive.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes

None submitted
